steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Film scene analysis requires systematic examination of how micro features including cinematography, mise-en-scene, editing and sound create meaning and generate response. | Key Fact: Begin by watching the extract at least twice: first for overall impression and narrative content, then for detailed identification of specific film language techniques. | Key Fact: Cinematography analysis covers shot type, camera angle, camera movement, composition, focus and lighting, each of which contributes to meaning and audience positioning. | Key Fact: Mise-en-scene analysis examines setting, props, costume, performance, hairstyle and makeup, considering how each element has been deliberately chosen to communicate meaning.
